Technology.materialsText: Moisture-resistant chipboard, veneer, and solid wood — every texture is chosen to stay flawless for years. 40+ finish options let you build a wardrobe that looks like it was designed specifically for your room.

Process.heading: How it works, step by step
Process.subtitle: From measuring the room to the finished wardrobe — three simple steps we go through together with you

steps.title: We measure the room
steps.text: Do it yourself with our guide, or have a specialist come measure the space precisely — accounting for every ledge, door, and vent, so the wardrobe fits like a glove, down to the millimeter.

steps.title: You build the configuration
steps.text: Series, number of sections, module layout, finishes and features — all tailored to your interior and budget.

steps.title: You get your finished wardrobe
steps.text: Turnkey manufacturing and installation — we deliver, assemble on site, and show you how to use every mechanism.

Production.detailAlt: A joiner working a wooden beam in the ARMADERO workshop
Production.heading: A workshop, not an assembly line
Production.text: ARMADERO is a team of joiners in Kyiv. Every wardrobe is built to order: a frame in moisture-resistant chipboard or solid oak, hardware from certified European suppliers, hand-assembled, joint to joint. Every mechanism is tested for 50,000 open cycles.

list.name: Olena Kovalchuk
list.text: We ordered a wardrobe for the whole bedroom wall. It arrived in 5 weeks, assembled in a day. Now everything has its place.

list.name: Ihor Tarasenko
list.text: We spent a long time picking the front finish — the ARMADERO team sent samples to our home so we could see the color in person. The result exceeded expectations.

list.name: Maryna Bondar
list.text: The soft-close hinges are silent, the shelf lighting turns on automatically — exactly what was missing. I recommend the Signature series.

list.name: Dmytro Savchuk
list.text: The measuring visit was free and fast. The site's configurator let us see right away what the wardrobe would look like.

list.name: Oleh Petrenko
list.text: We ordered a second module a year later to extend the wardrobe. The color and finish matched perfectly — you can't tell the difference.

list.name: Nataliia Hrytsenko
list.text: We chose the Comfort series — hardware quality on par with imported brands, but with local service and warranty.

list.name: Andrii Melnyk
list.text: Installation was done in one visit, and they showed us how to use the pull-out systems. A year later — no complaints about the mechanisms.

items.q: How much does a measuring visit cost?
items.a: Free within Kyiv. Elsewhere in Ukraine — we confirm the cost with your request, depending on distance.

items.q: Can I order a non-standard wardrobe configuration?
items.a: Yes, the modular system lets you build any layout — from a corner nook to a full walk-in room.

items.q: What's the warranty term for hardware and mechanisms?
items.a: 2 years on soft-close hinges, the motorized rail, and lighting; 5 years on the frame.

items.q: Can I order a wardrobe without lighting and a motorized rail?
items.a: Yes — the Lite series has laminate fronts with standard hardware, no technology package.

items.q: How much does delivery within Ukraine/the EU cost?
items.a: Calculated individually depending on the region and the wardrobe's size.
